start: Settings, tab Sign-in & data; the gym is saved in this browser only (not online, not the demo)

steps.action: Open Settings and pick the Sign-in & data tab
user_sees: Subtitle 'Your sign-in, staff, backups and your gym’s records'
The sign-in card first, then a card 'Download a backup', then a card 'Your gym’s records'
In 'Your gym’s records': a line counting the records and 'Set up <date>.'
'Saved in this browser only. Put your gym online (above) to keep it safe and open it anywhere.'
Buttons 'Import members from Excel', 'Load demo gym', 'Erase and start fresh'
must_not: The words 'Saved online' for a gym that is not online
'Offline copy on this device' or 'Danger zone' shown for a browser-only gym

user_sees: 'Download every member, plan, payment and check-in as an Excel file. Keep it on your phone or computer. We suggest once a month.'
After the tap: 'Downloaded: an Excel file and a full copy.' and the last-download line changes
must_not: The success words when no file was made
A file that misses members, payments or check-ins of this gym

user_sees: The import page opens
must_not: The button looks usable with no internet and then fails without a word

start: Other kind: the gym is online; Settings, tab Sign-in & data

user_sees: 'Saved online. Safe if a phone or computer breaks. The same on every phone or computer you sign in on.'
'MettleUp support can look at your records only if you let them. To let them, or to see when they looked, open Help and feedback → MettleUp access'
A block 'Offline copy on this device' with the button 'Clear offline copy'
A red line 'Danger zone: this can’t be undone'
must_not: 'Load demo gym', 'Erase and start fresh', 'Start over with a new demo gym' or 'Disconnect the shop' offered for online records

user_sees: With nothing waiting: 'Clear the offline copy on this device? Nothing is deleted from your gym’s records online.'
Buttons 'Yes, clear it' and 'Keep it'
With unsent desk work waiting: the question in red, naming what would be lost
must_not: The copy cleared on the first tap, before the question
Unsent money on this device cleared with the calm, non-red question

user_sees: 'Offline copy cleared. Your gym’s records online are safe. A fresh copy downloads while this device is online.'
must_not: Any member, payment or check-in removed from the gym’s records online
The done words when the clearing failed

start: Other kind: a demo gym with its shop, in this browser; Settings, tab Sign-in & data

user_sees: 'Saved in this browser only. A demo gym is never put online.'
A third red button 'Start over with a new demo gym'
must_not: 'Disconnect the shop' offered for a demo gym
A way to put the demo gym online from this card

steps.action: Tap 'Start over with a new demo gym'
user_sees: Sheet 'Start over with a new demo gym?'
Red box 'This replaces everything in this browser: <n> members, <n> payments and <n> check-ins. You can’t undo this.'
'This browser forgets this demo gym and its shop (gym code <code>). You go back to the first screen. There, Start demo makes a new gym with a new code.'
Buttons 'Cancel' and 'Start over'
must_not: Counts in the red box that differ from the records line on the card

user_sees: The first (welcome) screen of the admin app
must_not: The old demo gym or its gym code still shown after the tap
A real gym in this browser wiped by this button

start: Other kind: a real gym saved in this browser that turned the shop on; Settings, tab Sign-in & data

user_sees: Sheet 'Disconnect the shop?'

'Your members, plans, payments and check-ins stay as they are. This browser stops showing shop orders and products. You can’t manage gym code <code> from here any more. You also can’t reach members who already joined from this admin app.'
No red 'This replaces everything' box
Buttons 'Cancel' and 'Disconnect'
must_not: The red erase warning shown for a step that erases nothing

user_sees: Note 'Shop disconnected. Your members and payments are still here.'
The members, payments and check-in counts on the card unchanged
must_not: Any member, plan, payment or check-in removed
'Start over with a new demo gym' offered to a real gym

start: Settings, tab Sign-in & data; the gym is saved in this browser only and has members

user_sees: Sheet 'Erase everything?'
Red box 'This replaces everything in this browser: <n> members, <n> payments and <n> check-ins. You can’t undo this.'
'You will be left with an empty gym: no members, no plans, no payments.'
Buttons 'Cancel' and 'Erase everything'
must_not: Anything erased before the red button is pressed

user_sees: The sheet closes; the records line on the card is the same as before
must_not: A member, payment or check-in gone after Cancel

steps.action: Tap 'Download all your gym’s data' at a moment the file cannot be made
user_sees: 'Could not make the file. Try again.' in red
must_not: 'Downloaded: an Excel file and a full copy.' when nothing was saved
The last-download line moved to now

start: Settings, tab Sign-in & data; a browser-only gym with unsaved edits typed in the gym details boxes on the Gym tab

steps.action: Tap 'Load demo gym', read the sheet 'Load the demo gym?', tap 'Load demo gym'
user_sees: 'This makes a sample gym with about 128 members, their payments and check-ins. Use it to show someone the app. Don’t use it on a gym with real members.'
Note 'Demo gym loaded.'
The records line now counts the demo gym
must_not: The old gym’s UPI ID or name left in the gym details boxes of the demo gym
Members of the old gym mixed into the demo gym

steps.action: Tap 'Erase and start fresh', then 'Erase everything'
user_sees: Note 'Started fresh.'
The records line shows an empty gym; the gym keeps its saved name
must_not: Being thrown back to the welcome screen
The gym renamed to a name that was typed but never saved
Demo members left behind

user_sees: No wall of zero tiles; the gym code card and the shop card
must_not: Yesterday’s demo numbers still on Today

start: Privacy and promise: who can reach the backup, the erase buttons and the support-access line

steps.action: As the owner of an online gym, read the card 'Your gym’s records'
user_sees: 'MettleUp support can look at your records only if you let them.' with a link to Help and feedback → MettleUp access
must_not: The line shown to a front-desk login
The line shown for a gym that is not online

steps.action: Sign in as a front-desk person and open Settings
user_sees: Subtitle 'Screen colours, app and your sign-in'
Cards 'Dark or light', 'Members' with 'Import members from Excel', the sign-in card, the install card and the alerts card
must_not: 'Download a backup', 'Clear offline copy', 'Danger zone', 'Load demo gym' or 'Erase and start fresh' on a staff screen

steps.action: As the owner, download the backup and look at where the file went
user_sees: An Excel file and a full copy saved on this phone or computer only
must_not: The file sent anywhere by itself
Another gym’s rows in the file
